 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # The intact reference frame contains the pattern to be copied into frames of equal size.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    frames=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            col=grid[r][c]
            if col==0: continue
            # Candidate upper-left frame corner: frame's top and left edges are present.
            if c+2>=w or r+2>=h: continue
            # Determine extents from uninterrupted top/right/bottom/left border.
            c1=c
            while c1+1<w and grid[r][c1+1]==col: c1+=1
            r1=r
            while r1+1<h and grid[r1+1][c]==col: r1+=1
            if c1-c<2 or r1-r<2: continue
            if not all(grid[r1][x]==col for x in range(c,c1+1)): continue
            if not all(grid[y][c1]==col for y in range(r,r1+1)): continue
            frames.append((col,r,r1,c,c1))
    # Deduplicate candidates
    frames=list(dict.fromkeys(frames))
    ref=None
    for col,r0,r1,c0,c1 in frames:
        p=[[grid[y][x] for x in range(c0+1,c1)] for y in range(r0+1,r1)]
        if any(v!=0 for row in p for v in row):
            ref=(len(p),len(p[0]),p); break
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    if ref:
        ph,pw,p=ref
        for col,r0,r1,c0,c1 in frames:
            if (r1-r0-1,c1-c0-1)!=(ph,pw): continue
            # Fill only empty interior; never overwrite the reference.
            if all(out[y][x]==0 for y in range(r0+1,r1) for x in range(c0+1,c1)):
                for i in range(ph):
                    for j in range(pw): out[r0+1+i][c0+1+j]=p[i][j]
    return out

 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    # Full rectangle outlines: group border cells by color and bounding rectangle.
    for color in range(1,10):
        cells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==color]
        if not cells: continue
        r0=min(r for r,c in cells); r1=max(r for r,c in cells); c0=min(c for r,c in cells); c1=max(c for r,c in cells)
        if r1-r0<2 or c1-c0<2: continue
        # outline candidates only if perimeter all same color
        if not (all(grid[r0][c]==color and grid[r1][c]==color for c in range(c0,c1+1)) and all(grid[r][c0]==color and grid[r][c1]==color for r in range(r0,r1+1))): continue
        # discern pattern inside this frame
        pat=[[grid[r][c] for c in range(c0+1,c1)] for r in range(r0+1,r1)]
        if not any(v for row in pat for v in row): continue
        ph,pw=len(pat),len(pat[0])
        # replicate contents from filled frame into every empty frame of same dimensions
        for co in range(1,10):
            cs=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==co]
            if not cs: continue
            a=min(r for r,c in cs); b=max(r for r,c in cs); x=min(c for r,c in cs); y=max(c for r,c in cs)
            if (b-a-1,y-x-1)!=(ph,pw): continue
            if not (all(grid[a][j]==co and grid[b][j]==co for j in range(x,y+1)) and all(grid[i][x]==co and grid[i][y]==co for i in range(a,b+1))): continue
            if all(grid[i][j]==0 for i in range(a+1,b) for j in range(x+1,y)):
                for i in range(ph):
                    for j in range(pw): out[a+1+i][x+1+j]=pat[i][j]
    return out

if __name__ == '__main__': pass
",
 "cross_profile": false
}
